lexer.class: $ ' @ \ ` ~, control bytes 00-08/0B-0C/0E-1F, DEL, and every UTF-8 scalar outside U+0800-U+0FFF (byte by byte), plus stray continuation bytes; a malformed/truncated 0xE0 sequence is a hard E_UTF8 error, not a skip
not_swallowed: Devanagari digits 0-9 (and Gujarati, Bengali, Gurmukhi, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada digits)
silent_wrong_answers: ~ \ $ in the operator's place (discarded expression statement)
lexer.v321_agreement: Claude's v321 (R182) refuses at the same place with new code E_AGYAT_AKSHAR plus a hint table and a BOM carve-out; the independently-derived class agrees, and its hints agree with this list on every row covered
